description: Run one bash command line; the working folder is your workspace. Returns stdout and stderr merged; the last line is always [exit code N], your command's exit code (non-zero there is a result, not a tool error). Keeps the last 2000 lines or 50KB. Timeout 30 s by default, at most 300; then the process group is stopped (CommandFailed). Use it to search (grep, find) and run programs; use ls to list a folder. It is not a sandbox: the command can touch anything your Linux user can.
